answer: Require established agents to vouch for each new identity by locking part of their own stake on the endorsement. If that recruit is later proven a farm, the vouchers are slashed as well, so honest agents refuse cheap signatures. An attacker then has to buy scarce endorsements or burn established capital for every extra shell, keeping marginal cost high. A public violet tag on thinly vouched accounts stops influence from beginning to spiral out of a lagoon of unbacked identities.
